name: routing-card
title: Production routing card
for_each: select min(id::text)::uuid id,order_code from scheduling.operations group by order_code

sections.title: Operation route
sections.note: Planning record only. Confirm materials, competence and machine controls before work.
sections.sql: select code,sequence,machine,operator,setup_minutes,run_minutes,ready_at,due_at,status,material_ready,note from scheduling.operation_list where order_code=(select order_code from scheduling.operations where id=$1) order by sequence

sections.title: Planned shutdowns
sections.sql: select closed_on,reason from scheduling.closures where resource_id=$1 order by closed_on

sections.title: Assigned work
sections.sql: select code,order_code,setup_minutes,run_minutes,due_at,status from scheduling.operations where machine_id=$1 or operator_id=$1 order by due_at
